question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

To throw down the gauntlet

options.text: To challenge somebody to do something

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"To throw down the gauntlet"** means to challenge someone to a contest or competition. (किसी को चुनौती देना)

 
 
• **Example: **The new player decided **to throw down the gauntlet **and challenge the reigning champion.
 
 
 
• **"To challenge somebody to do something"** refers to daring someone to prove their ability or to confront them with a task. (किसी को कुछ करने की चुनौती देना)
 
 
• **Example: **He **threw down the gauntlet **by challenging her to a debate on the topic.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To surrender** (समर्पण करना): To give up or yield.

 
 
• **Example:** The soldiers decided to surrender after realizing they were outnumbered.
 
 
 
• **To ignore without any reason** (बिना किसी कारण अनदेखा करना): To disregard or overlook someone or something without any particular reason.
 
 
• **Example:** She felt hurt when her friends ignored her without any reason.
 
 
 
• **To plead for mercy** (दया की याचना करना): To beg for compassion or leniency.
 
 
• **Example:** The prisoner pleaded for mercy before the judge.
